coverage.finding: An arrow-labeled module diagram is a possible editorial aid for the exact sequence and its finite-separable specialization. The sequence already appears correctly as displayed mathematics in the preview; no mathematical defect was found, so adding a separate diagram is optional.

arrows.map: [x] -> dx tensor 1 for x in m
arrows.check: Well-defined on classes modulo m^2; the statement asserts this is the injective first map.

arrows.map: induced by R -> kappa; dr tensor lambda -> lambda d(r mod m)
arrows.check: The composite from m/m^2 is zero, and the sequence is stated to be exact.

diagram_details.specialization: When kappa/k is finite separable, Omega_{kappa/k}=0; the exact sequence then identifies the first arrow as an isomorphism m/m^2 ~= Omega_{R/k} tensor_R kappa.
diagram_details.dimension_check: All displayed terms are kappa-vector spaces. No numerical ranks are asserted in the source. Exactness gives dim_kappa(Omega_{R/k} tensor_R kappa)=dim_kappa(m/m^2)+dim_kappa(Omega_{kappa/k}); these dimensions are finite under the stated Noetherian and finitely-generated-residue hypotheses.
hypotheses_to_show: R is a Noetherian local k-algebra with maximal ideal m and residue field kappa=R/m.
For short exactness, kappa is finitely generated and separably generated over k.
The specialization to an isomorphism additionally assumes kappa/k is finite separable.
diagram_details.scope_caveat: Do not imply that Omega_{kappa/k}=0 for every separably generated residue extension; the vanishing and isomorphism are only asserted in the finite-separable case.
